items.headline: Six Malaysian men jailed and caned over a S$4.9m armed robbery at a King Albert Park bungalow
items.summary: A gang stormed a Good Class Bungalow with machetes and baseball bats and robbed poker players of S$4.9 million; ringleaders Wong and Goh were each jailed 12 years 11 months with 24 strokes of the cane.

items.headline: Driver who showed police a screenshot of another man's licence while banned is jailed
items.summary: A 31-year-old motorist crashed while driving under a suspension, then flashed officers a photo of someone else's licence; jailed 13 weeks, fined S$3,400 and disqualified for five years.

items.headline: One person dies in a fire at a Lorong Lew Lian flat
items.summary: A blaze broke out at a unit in the Lorong Lew Lian estate near Upper Serangoon, killing one occupant; police and SCDF are investigating.

items.headline: Photographer urges Tampines town council to spare an iconic HDB block's brick facade
items.summary: Photographer Darren Soh asked the Tampines town council and its MP to reconsider plans to paint over the brick facade of blocks along Tampines Street 45.

items.headline: India's retail inflation climbs to 4.82% in August, its 10th straight monthly rise
items.summary: Consumer prices rose 4.82% year-on-year in August, up from 4.45% in July, driven by 5.95% food inflation and high fuel costs, nearing the top of the RBI's 2-6% band.

items.headline: India's IPO market heats up, with a dozen share sales lined up before the NSE's own listing
items.summary: Six mainboard IPOs opened in one day and more than a dozen are slated this week seeking a combined 72 billion rupees, ahead of the National Stock Exchange's own listing.

items.headline: India's top court drops cases against Gen-Z 'Cockroach' protesters, easing a standoff with Modi
items.summary: A Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant ordered criminal cases dropped against Cockroach Janta Party student protesters and barred fresh cases, prompting the group to call off a planned march.

items.headline: Modi says India's 7.8% growth 'gives confidence to the world'
items.summary: With India holding its place as the fastest-growing major economy, PM Narendra Modi said its 7.8% expansion is a source of global confidence even as conflicts and supply-chain strains persist.

items.headline: A Reform-linked think tank urges Britain to slash taxes on the rich and let the City take bigger risks
items.summary: A blueprint from a think tank close to Nigel Farage's Reform UK calls for deep tax cuts for high earners and lighter-touch financial regulation to spur growth.

items.headline: Labour extends its poll lead as Reform grapples with a campaign-finance probe
items.summary: Andy Burnham's Labour stretched its lead over Reform UK, which is in turmoil after undercover footage showed senior figures discussing how to route foreign money into the party.

items.headline: Canada's Carney to meet Burnham as Ottawa deepens its ties with Europe
items.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney will meet UK PM Andy Burnham as Canada seeks stronger trade and security links with Britain and the EU.

items.headline: Burnham's Parliament debut leaves MPs pressing for concrete plans
items.summary: In his first despatch-box appearance as PM, Andy Burnham vowed to bring back hope and put the cost of living first, but drew criticism for offering more style than specifics.

items.headline: A war-damaged building collapses in Gaza City, killing at least 21
items.summary: The six-storey al-Saada building, cracked by an earlier Israeli strike, collapsed overnight, killing at least 21 people including 12 children; nearly 100 residents may be trapped.

items.headline: The US moves to approve about 60,000 heavy bombs for Israel
items.summary: The Trump administration is set to clear a large new sale of 2,000-pound bombs to Israel, one of the biggest single munitions packages of the war.

items.headline: The US confirms it has deployed weapons in orbit, drawing a warning from China
items.summary: Air Force Secretary Troy Meink said the US Space Force has placed weapons in space to defend American forces, the first such public acknowledgment; Beijing warned against an arms race.

items.headline: Russian spy satellites may be helping Iran target US forces in the Gulf
items.summary: A CNN investigation found Russian reconnaissance satellites passed over a US base in Saudi Arabia days before one of Iran's most precise strikes, suggesting Moscow's assets aided targeting.

items.headline: China opens the Pinglu Canal, a new gateway to Southeast Asia
items.summary: The Pinglu Canal, a major inland waterway linking China's southwest to the Gulf of Tonkin, gives Beijing a faster shipping route to Southeast Asia.

items.headline: OpenAI weighs a funding round valuing it above $1.2 trillion
items.summary: Investors have approached OpenAI about a new round valuing the ChatGPT maker above $1.2 trillion as it scales compute and products.

items.headline: Altman rules out an OpenAI IPO this year, citing AI-safety concerns
items.summary: Sam Altman said a 2026 listing would be ill-advised and that OpenAI will not go public until at least 2027, prioritising safety as the technology advances.

items.headline: Anthropic's Amodei proposes a plan to slow the pace of advancing AI
items.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei set out a proposal for the industry to throttle how fast frontier AI capabilities advance, warning the race leaves too little time to manage risks.

items.headline: Amazon gives OpenAI's advertising push a boost with a ChatGPT partnership
items.summary: Amazon agreed to work with OpenAI on advertising as OpenAI builds an ad business that has reached a $1 billion annualised revenue run rate.

items.headline: The Federal Reserve raises rates to 3.75%-4%, its first hike since 2023
items.summary: Fed policymakers lifted the funds target a quarter point to 3.75%-4%, the first hike in three years, as Chair Kevin Warsh flagged sticky inflation.

items.headline: Wall Street sells off as the Dow sinks about 631 points after the Fed
items.summary: US stocks fell, with the Dow closing down roughly 631 points at 51,461.90 and the S&P 500 off about 0.45% at 7,551.81, as Warsh's hawkish tone unsettled investors.

items.headline: The 10-year Treasury yield tops 5% as the Fed signals more tightening may follow
items.summary: Long-dated US borrowing costs jumped, with the 10-year yield climbing back above 5%, after the Fed's projections showed most officials expect at least one more hike.

items.headline: Analysts say Warsh's rate hike reinforces Fed independence after Trump's pressure
items.summary: Raising rates despite months of White House pressure to ease was read as a signal of the central bank's independence; Warsh has declined to submit a dot since taking the chair.

items.headline: India beat Afghanistan by seven wickets to take an unbeatable 2-0 T20I lead
items.summary: India chased down 160 with 31 balls to spare in the second T20I in Delhi to go 2-0 up in the series, a near-repeat of their seven-wicket win in the opener.

items.headline: Team Europe finalises its Laver Cup squad for London's O2
items.summary: Casper Ruud took the last Team Europe place alongside world No. 1 Carlos Alcaraz and Alexander Zverev for the Laver Cup at The O2 from Sep 25-27, facing Andre Agassi's Team World.

items.headline: Verstappen re-signs with Red Bull through 2030, settling F1's 2027 driver market
items.summary: Max Verstappen ended months of speculation about McLaren or endurance racing by extending his Red Bull deal to 2030, removing the biggest domino from the 2027 grid.

items.headline: Mercedes keeps Antonelli and Russell for 2027 as the pair lead the title race
items.summary: Mercedes confirmed it will retain Kimi Antonelli and George Russell for a third season together, with the teammates first and second in the standings; Antonelli leads by 81 points.

items.headline: F1's Azerbaijan Grand Prix shifts to a Saturday for a national day of remembrance
items.summary: The Baku round has been moved forward a day to Saturday Sep 26, so it does not clash with Azerbaijan's Sep 27 remembrance for the 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh war.

items.headline: Fuel savings could double the working life of NASA's Roman Space Telescope
items.summary: NASA said a precise first mid-course correction and other fuel savings should more than double the potential operating lifetime of the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope.

items.headline: Physicists report an unexplained particle event in the LZ dark-matter hunt
items.summary: Scientists on the LZ experiment said they recorded a collision they cannot yet explain in their search for dark matter, stirring cautious interest in the field.

items.headline: An AI system claims a breakthrough on the Navier-Stokes 'Millennium' problem
items.summary: Nature reported that an OpenAI model generated a solution suggesting the Navier-Stokes equations can break down, a claim tied to a $1-million Millennium Prize Problem now under scrutiny.

items.headline: NASA's Roman Space Telescope launches to map dark energy and hunt exoplanets
items.summary: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, built to probe dark energy and survey hundreds of millions of galaxies, reached orbit after a successful launch.

fun_fact.headline: There are more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way
fun_fact.body: Earth is home to roughly 3 trillion trees (2015 Nature study led by Thomas Crowther), while the Milky Way is estimated to hold only about 100 to 400 billion stars.

puzzle.title: There and Back
puzzle.body: A cyclist rides from A to B at 15 km/h and returns along the same road at 10 km/h. What is her average speed for the round trip?
puzzle.approach: Average speed is total distance over total time, not the mean of the two speeds.
puzzle.answer: 12 km/h (harmonic mean of 15 and 10; time = d/15 + d/10 = d/6, distance = 2d, so 2d/(d/6) = 12).

word_puzzle.title: Prime Position
word_puzzle.body: Centre letter T; outer letters A B E L N O. Find 4+ letter words containing T using only these seven letters; one pangram uses all seven.
word_puzzle.approach: Every word must include the centre letter T and use only the seven letters (repeats allowed).
word_puzzle.answer: Pangram NOTABLE; others include BEAT, BENT, BELT, BOLT, BOAT, NOTE, TONE, TABLE, TALON, TONAL, TOTAL, BATON, BLOAT, LATTE, BATTLE, BOTTLE, OBLATE, ABLATE.
